_about: Every number on index.html is a data-fig span whose text must equal a value here. tools/check-figures.py refuses the page otherwise. status is one of measured | projected | planned. source names the repository, commit and file or section the value was read from; command is how to take it again.

lines.label: lines in the decoder, both files
lines.source: sravan@85f90b2 kernel/nihshesha.t1 (1,159) + kernel/mapana.t1 (131); vendored here under kernel/

foreign.label: lines of C, C++, Rust or assembly in the decode path
foreign.source: sravan kernel/ contains only .t1 and README.md; the Python under reference/ is the encoder and the oracle, not the decode path

frames.label: complete FLAC frames graded, plus three that must be refused

headers.label: complete frame headers, all four code spaces enumerated

typecodes.label: subframe type codes, 39 legal and 25 reserved, every one classified or refused

mutations.label: kernel mutations, each caught by the subject built for it
mutations.command: count the kernel-mutation rows in THESIS.md §8c

crc8.label: CRC-8 over b"123456789", the published check value
crc8.source: sravan THESIS.md §8c; catalogue value for poly 0x07
crc8.command: python3 -c "import crcmod" or any published CRC catalogue

crc16.label: CRC-16/UMTS over b"123456789", the published check value
crc16.source: sravan THESIS.md §8c; catalogue value for poly 0x8005 init 0

ipcs.label: instructions per channel-sample, native RV64, stereo mid/side LPC order 8 at the corpus ratio, octet-wise CRC
ipcs.source: sravan@85f90b2, THESIS.md §6 S1 table CRC row; 1,535,695 per frame

realtime.label: real time, from 1,500 instructions per channel-sample at 1 GHz and one instruction per cycle, the most pessimistic machine anyone ships; not timed on silicon

crcshare.label: share of decode cost spent in CRC-16 after the octet-wise table; was 37.1% before it
crcshare.source: sravan@85f90b2; THESIS.md §6 S1, 367,838 of 1,535,695 per frame
crcshare.command: reference/gentiming.py against a kernel with CRC-16 removed

ratio.label: coded size versus flac -8, the ENCODER, in Python, as an exact bit count and not an emitted stream

corpus.label: IETF FLAC test files the encoder figure covers; nothing skipped

toolchain.label: MB, the whole Sassembly toolchain: 12,124,352 octets

fixpoint_date.label: the day the compiler compiled itself byte for byte

attest_k.label: instruction sets that must yield one digest of the decoded samples; Darśana reached this for a transform, Naad has not yet
attest_k.source: sravan THESIS.md §6 S4; Darsan README decode_hash_agreement = 1 at k = 3

drift.label: frame-to-frame drift in decode cost: the model predicted 12,097,471 instructions for a run and 12,097,471 were measured
drift.source: naad HANDOFF.md at 620b1b3, carried from sravan reference/gentiming.py
drift.command: reference/gentiming.py, predicted vs measured instruction count

engines.label: independent engines that must agree on every result: an interpreter on the source, and the compiled RISC-V image
engines.command: t1_image --predict-only (interpreter) and yantra-run (native) on the same test

rt_phone.label: real time on a phone big core, 2.4 GHz at 2 instructions per cycle, from the same 1,500 instructions per channel-sample

core_phone.label: of one phone big core busy decoding stereo 44.1 kHz; 2.8% rounded up
core_phone.source: projection from sravan@85f90b2 ipcs at 2.4 GHz, IPC 2

rt_laptop.label: real time on a laptop core, 3.5 GHz at 3 instructions per cycle

crc_gain.label: whole-decoder speedup from the octet-wise CRC, inside the 1.20–1.28× band registered before the build
crc_gain.source: sravan@85f90b2 commit message and THESIS.md §6 S1

dyn.label: times louder: RMS of 140-150 s against RMS of 0-10 s of the Grieg recording, 24.3 dB, which is 16.4x in amplitude
dyn.source: tools/song-wave.py over the Commons original; opening -37.5 dBFS, ending -13.2 dBFS

song_fmt.label: format of the source recording and of the shipped excerpt
song_fmt.source: ffprobe on the Commons original, shipped unchanged as grieg-mountain-king.flac (md5 4655be52db91a64bac7b575f4124e9e4)

song_len.label: length of the whole recording, 154.09 s

s_norm.label: kbps of the Normal-quality stream version, Ogg Vorbis, made from the same master

s_high.label: kbps of the High-quality stream version, Ogg Vorbis, made from the same master
